description: Find candidate qualifications by code/name, industry and RPL, gap training or online pathway. Search before asking for missing personal details. Returns candidates, not an eligibility assessment. Pure RPL prices are labelled by residency; gap/online prices require details. Use get_rpl_qualification to explain requirements and calculate conditional quotes. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

hasPrice.description: Only explicitly filter when requested. True = any public quote for the selected path/identity, false = none. Gap/online may require detail checks; narrow the query if requested.

industry.description: Industry key from the industries list returned by this tool.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

residency.description: resident = PR/citizen; nonResident = temporary visa holder in Australia; offshore = outside Australia. Never infer a missing identity.

name: search_rpl_qualifications
title: Search RPL qualifications
